info.title: Corely IAM Migration CLI
info.description: Command-line tool that creates and migrates the Corely IAM database schema. Ships the SQL Server and MySQL migrations, so a consumer of the Corely.IAM package can stand up a database without referencing anything beyond this tool.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create the database and apply all migrations

options.name: --provider
options.description: Database provider (MySql, MsSql). Falls back to CORELY_IAM_DB_PROVIDER.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: Database connection string. Falls back to CORELY_IAM_DB_CONNECTION.

options.name: --history-table
options.description: Migrations history table. Defaults to __CorelyIamMigrationsHistory. Pass __EFMigrationsHistory for a database migrated before that default existed.
